TOPIC 4.5
Solving Related 
Rates Problems

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

CHA-3.E
Interpret related rates in 
applied contexts.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

CHA-3.E.1
The derivative can be used to solve related 
rates problems; that is, finding a rate at which 
one quantity is changing by relating it to other 
quantities whose rates of change are known.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

CHA-3
Derivatives allow us to solve real-world problems involving rates of change.
